description.value: Jacob's Noodle & Cutlet is a Japanese and Korean takeout spot in downtown Kamloops, serving dishes like gyoza, sashimi, katsu, takoyaki, and Korean-inspired chicken. The menu is built around comfort-food staples prepared consistently, with online ordering available for pickup. It sits in the city core, making it a practical mid-ride food stop for cyclists moving through Kamloops.
